name: 망나니
weapon: Oversized Korean Joseon execution sword, very broad heavy SINGLE EDGED steel blade with a slightly curved rounded point, dark forged steel spine and bright sharpened edge, long two-handed oxblood leather handle, small rectangular iron guard, one subtle dark-red spiritual crack. It is an executioner's blade, not an axe, not a European crossguard greatsword.
body: A muscular Korean male executioner in his thirties or forties, bare strong forearms, messy dark topknot, rough charcoal and oxblood red-brown hemp work clothes, wide-legged navy black baji trousers and dark cloth shoes. Holds one very broad Korean single-edged execution sword in both hands, angled upright beside his right shoulder (viewer left), so his face, torso and both feet remain visible. A long oxblood grip, small rectangular iron guard, dark iron blade spine with a bright silver cutting edge; no huge fantasy crossguard. The blade should make a broad aggressive silhouette but stay wholly inside the frame.
color: charcoal, dark red brown, muted vermilion, cold steel
refinement: Broadened single-edged execution blade in both concept plate and held sprite.
frontReferencePolicy: The final front PNG defines identity and actual equipment placement; preserve it for future south-reference rotations. Do not mirror asymmetric equipment.
